With `optimization.model_snapshot_index="flat"` on a multi-period network, model construction calls `define_secant_loss_constraints` with the original MultiIndex `sns` inside `_flat_snapshots_context(n, True)`. That context makes snapshot-indexed component data (`c.da`), including line data, use flat tuple-labelled snapshots instead of the MultiIndex representation of the supplied snapshots.
